# Conformance coverage

SVGeeKit vs. the vendored W3C SVG 1.1 Second Edition test suite. Each chapter page shows our committed render next to the W3C reference PNG.

Generated from [`conformance-report.json`](conformance-report.json) on 2026-08-20. Regenerate with `swift run CoverageReport` after a full conformance run. Do not hand-edit.

## Totals (535 tests)

| Status | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| `passed` | 229 |
| `partialBaseline` | 73 |
| `skipped` | 233 |

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `passed` | Render matches a human-verified baseline. |
| `partialBaseline` | Render is captured and tracked, but **not** yet verified against the W3C pass criteria. |
| `skipped` | Explicitly out of scope (`overrides.json`). |
| `failed` | Diverged from a verified baseline. |
| `parseError` / `renderError` | The test threw before a snapshot could be compared. |

## Images

Thumbnails are relative links into committed files — they load in GitHub's markdown viewer:

- **SVGeeKit** — `Tests/__Snapshots__/<id>/baseline.png` when `passed` (verified), or `Tests/__PartialSnapshots__/<id>/baseline.png` when `partialBaseline` (unverified).
- **W3C reference** — `Tests/SVGConformanceTests/Resources/W3C-SVG-1.1/png/<id>.png`.
- Skipped tests and parse/render errors have no SVGeeKit snapshot.
